title: README's no-JS 'no hidden attrs' claim is falsified by its own committed capture; co-applicant upload slots + extra income rows are unreachable without JS
evidence: README.md:24: "PASS — curl (no JS): GET renders all 8 data-section-id with no hidden attrs, both attestation radios (attested/declined, required)" — but committed 17-nojs-long-form.html contains 5 hidden attrs: `<div class="income-source-row" data-index="0" data-initially-hidden="true" data-testid="income-source-row-0" hidden>` (rows 0/1/2) and two `<div data-condition="co_applicant_sharing" data-condition-value="yes" hidden>` wrappers containing `data-testid="upload-proof-of-income-coapplicant-0"` and `data-testid="upload-employer-ref-coapplicant-0"`.
detail: The 8 section wrappers are unhidden, but 5 inner containers are hidden and only JS removes the attribute (add-income-source button; co_applicant_sharing watcher). A no-JS applicant with a rent-sharing co-applicant or extra income cannot reach those optional inputs; the pass's claim as written is inaccurate and that path went unexercised.
recommended_fix: Correct the README wording to 'no hidden attrs on the 8 section wrappers' and either note the no-JS-hidden optional clusters as a known limitation or file it as a defect.

title: Removing the old .claude fixtures ignore leaves stale generated fixtures unignored on pre-migration working copies
evidence: Diff hunk: `-.claude/skills/form-bug-hunt/helpers/fixtures/` / `+.pi/skills/form-bug-hunt/helpers/fixtures/`; generate-fixtures.sh:26 `cd "$(dirname "$0")/fixtures"` (fixtures generated untracked, ignored); .gitignore retains other .claude entries (`87:.claude/worktrees/`, `102:.claude/skills/bmad-*`) but not the form-bug-hunt fixtures path.
detail: Git removes only tracked files on pull, so an ignored, generated fixtures/ dir under .claude/skills/form-bug-hunt/helpers/ survives the skill move on any clone that ran generate-fixtures.sh pre-migration; with the old pattern deleted those files become unignored untracked noise and can be swept into an accidental commit.
recommended_fix: Keep the old `.claude/skills/form-bug-hunt/helpers/fixtures/` ignore line alongside the new one for one transition cycle, or document deleting the stale directory.

title: Committed analytics evidence is a double-encoded JSON string — single parse yields a string, not the object
detail: README row 7 cites this file as the token-leak evidence, but any scripted consumer (jq, JSON.parse) gets a string on first decode and cannot read tokenInAnyPayload/botFilterUA without a second parse; a one-shot verification script would silently fail property lookups.
recommended_fix: Rewrite the artifact as a plain JSON object (strip the outer string encoding) so the evidence is machine-readable with a single parse.
